facts.fact: Eravi is the stooped fort physician who bleeds Devan twice and despairs.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a physician who bleeds him and despairs.

facts.fact: Devan's raider arrow-graze is along the outside of his left forearm. The arrowhead was dung-smeared, so the wound festers with red lines up the arm.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the arrow-graze gone bad.

facts.fact: A cotton curtain hangs inside the warden's chamber window, behind the shutters.
facts.why: needed because Devan's line 'Draw the curtain' requires one.

facts.fact: Neela counts twenty-nine nights left on the night of chapter 13. Janu opened the shutters that evening by Devan's father's rule that a sick room breathes.
facts.why: needed because it follows the night counts and explains the open shutters on the fever night.

facts.fact: Neela had intended to leave her guild report at the meeting stone for Ammu on the night of chapter 13, and missed it to stay with Devan.
facts.why: needed because the beat says her guild report is due that night.
